title: Elliptic-billiard invariant k_{120}
statement: Fix an ellipse with center $O$ and foci $f_1,f_2$, and let $P=(P_i)_{i=1}^N$ range over its Poncelet family of $N$-periodic billiard orbits tangent to a fixed confocal caustic. Let $P'$ be the outer polygon formed by consecutive tangent intersections and $P''$ the inner polygon of caustic tangency points; write $A,A',A''$ for their areas. Here $\theta_i$ is the angle of $P$ at $P_i$, $L$ is its perimeter, and $l_i=|P''_i-P_i|$, $r_i=|P_{i+1}-P''_i|$. Prove that, for all $N$, the quantity $\sum_i\cos\angle P_i f_1 P_{i+1}$ is constant as $P$ varies through the family. The source labels this assertion invariant code k_{120}.
